name: Parrying Strike (Combat)
body:
Your critical hits leave foes out of position to attack you easily.

Benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit with a melee attack against a target, you gain a +2 competence bonus to AC against attacks made by that target until the end of your next turn. Your bonus to AC increases to +3 if your weapon has greater than a x2 critical multiplier.
